comment: SIRA browser-automation bridge policy — enforced in code by src/desktop-bridge/browser/policy.ts and src/desktop-bridge/browser/dispatch.ts. This feature grants SIRA's parent conversation semantic (CSS-selector based) control of a Playwright-driven browser with NO per-action approval gate — the safety net is this file's URL denylist plus the SAME runtime kill switch the desktop bridge already has (POST /api/desktop-bridge/kill). Only enable this on a machine fully dedicated to SIRA.
